method.yaw_rate: gyro (bias from quietest platform dwell) projected on unit up vector (accel low-passed 0.4 Hz, continuous), low-passed 1 Hz; + = left turn regardless of phone orientation
method.grids: N=400 section fraction depart->arrive; L0 = wall-clock fraction (pause -> NaN); L1 = dead-reckoned distance fraction (gravity = section mean accel, PCA along-track axis, v=0 both ends, speed held across pauses)
method.metrics: Pearson r; best r within +-10% shift; DTW (dtaidistance, window 10%) on z-normalised signals
method.nulls: partner run time-reversed; partner run block-shuffled (8 blocks, 20 draws); pairs of different physical sections (incl. R0.5 OXC-LST sections)
method.magnetometer: |B| of 1 Hz low-passed vector; raw runs bias-corrected by raw-group hard-iron centre [-117.6, 65.8, -137.2] uT from outputs/qc.json; Δ|B| = |B| high-passed 0.05 Hz

a_gyro_yaw.justification: Yaw-rate signatures repeat. Clean same-section pairs on the L1 distance grid (best r within +-10% shift): EB LST->BTH: r = 0.76, 0.91, 0.96, 0.95, 0.94, 0.82, 0.77, 0.74, 0.76, 0.94, 0.90, 0.95, 0.95, 0.97, 0.94 (surrogate p <= 0.010, surrogate p99 0.73); EB BTH->MLE: r = 0.90, 0.91, 0.90, 0.99, 0.95, 0.96 (surrogate p <= 0.005, surrogate p99 0.86); WB MLE->BTH: r = 0.98, 0.97, 0.93, 0.98, 0.94, 0.94 (surrogate p <= 0.010, surrogate p99 0.91); WB BTH->LST: r = 0.87, 0.71, 0.86, 0.87, 0.73, 0.92, 0.85, 0.80, 0.79, 0.92 (surrogate p <= 0.025, surrogate p99 0.72); EB LST->ALE: r = 0.72 (surrogate p <= 0.060, surrogate p99 0.78); EB ALE->WCL: fewer than 2 clean runs, not scored. Different-section null: mean 0.23, max 0.84. Low-information: EB BTH->MLE, WB MLE->BTH is essentially one broad curve, so even spectrum-matched random signals reach r ~0.85; it repeats but carries little positional detail. Total heading change, clean runs (mean +- sd, deg): EB LST->BTH -57.2 +- 1.2, EB BTH->MLE +28.1 +- 0.3, WB MLE->BTH -28.7 +- 0.3, WB BTH->LST +50.4 +- 2.5, EB LST->ALE +44.0 +- 0.8; part of the sd comes from section-boundary placement (~+-5 s). Opposite direction over the same track (WB reversed, sign-flipped): LST-BTH: plain r 0.39, best r within +-25% 0.74 at shift -2% (surrogate p 0.010, 0.005, 0.244, 0.015, 0.030, 0.005, 0.025, 0.502, 0.005, 0.005, 0.005, 0.005, 0.353, 0.005, 0.005, 0.005, 0.005, 0.308, 0.010, 0.010, 0.015, 0.005, 0.279, 0.005, 0.050, 0.005, 0.005, 0.323, 0.010, 0.005); BTH-MLE: plain r 0.77, best r within +-25% 0.88 at shift -2% (surrogate p 0.050, 0.045, 0.060, 0.020, 0.050, 0.080, 0.020, 0.015, 0.040, 0.080, 0.045, 0.015, 0.040, 0.080, 0.055, 0.070). The EB/WB match needs a few-% shift and is weaker than same-direction; the two bores are not identical near LST. Caveats: 2-3 runs per group, one phone, one morning; distance is a dead-reckoned proxy, not ground truth.

b_magnetometer.justification: No usable position-locked |B| map from these runs. iOS re-estimated the calibration offset mid-ride on R1.5, R2, R3, R4, R6 (one-sample jumps of 80-369 uT with the phone still, qc.json), so only 1 calibrated same-section pair(s) are jump-free: R3:LST-BTH vs R5:LST-BTH r 0.24 (p 0.557), against a calibrated-only different-section null of mean 0.49, max 0.69. With the jumps masked, high-passed d|B| gives 3/7 pairs at surrogate p < 0.05 (r = 0.27, 0.42, 0.41, 0.31, 0.27, 0.21, 0.48; null mean 0.29, max 0.65); 4/8 pairs have positive plain r. Scattered weak matches, not consistent across runs. |along-track accel| repeats between runs (r 0.96) but scores 0.59 between DIFFERENT sections too, so it is not position evidence and the contrast says nothing about the field source; after regressing |B| on |a| and speed (a weak linear proxy for traction current) between-run r is 0.18. Calibration jumps are a confound that has not been separated from train and tunnel fields. Raw runs (R0.5, R1) are not pooled into these numbers.
